review:
Merge Up 2 in candy form, with relaxing ASMR pop sounds. Jelly bears and bubblegum stacks merge into higher levels after each win.

The new part is Booster modes, which can fill the grid with cell multipliers up to 128x from the very first spin – more potential straight away, for a higher price. Three bonus buy modes too. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins are rare, around once every 409 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 409 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
